question: Nayanars saints were devoted to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shiva**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **Nayanars** were a group of **63 Tamil saints** who lived during the 6th to 9th centuries CE. They were ardent devotees of **Lord Shiva**__ and contributed significantly to Shaivism in South India. 
• The Nayanars composed devotional hymns in praise of **Lord Shiva**, which are collectively known as the **Tirumurai**. These hymns are considered sacred scriptures in Shaivism. 
• They played a crucial role in the **Bhakti Movement** in Tamil Nadu, which emphasized personal devotion to God over ritualistic practices or caste-based hierarchies.
